content.text: Every year The town was built anyway. The river floods every spring. Nobody remembers a dry year.
The church still stands. Its bell rings for every flood.
Farmers moved uphill after 1952. Their old fields became marsh.
In the end, the river decides.

Every year The town was built anyway. The river floods every spring. Nobody remembers a dry year.
The church still stands. Its bell rings for every flood.
Farmers moved uphill after 1952. Their old fields became marsh.
In the end, the river decides.
